# PrintGrams

> Free, browser-based 3D printing calculators and reference tables. Every calculator shows its formula; every data table lists its sources. Nothing is uploaded.

## Calculators
- [3D Print Cost Calculator](https://printgrams.com/tools/3d-print-cost-calculator): Work out exactly what a 3D print costs: filament by weight or length, electricity, printer wear, failure rate, labour and markup. Free, no sign-up.
- [STL Analyzer & Viewer](https://printgrams.com/tools/stl-analyzer): Drop an STL, OBJ or 3MF to see size, volume, surface area, filament weight, print time and cost. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Filament Length ↔ Weight Converter](https://printgrams.com/tools/filament-length-weight-converter): Convert filament metres to grams and grams to metres for PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, nylon and more, at 1.75 mm or 2.85 mm. Uses real material densities.
- [Filament Remaining on Spool](https://printgrams.com/tools/spool-remaining-calculator): Find out how many grams and metres are left on a spool by weighing it, with empty spool weights for Bambu, Prusament, eSUN, Sunlu and more.
- [3D Printer Electricity Cost](https://printgrams.com/tools/3d-printer-electricity-cost): Calculate the electricity cost of a 3D print or a month of printing. Wattage presets for 37 printers and local tariffs for 18 countries.
- [Print Pricing for Sellers](https://printgrams.com/tools/print-pricing-for-sellers): Set a price for your 3D prints that keeps your target profit after Etsy, eBay, Amazon Handmade or Shopify fees and shipping.
- [Resin Print Cost Calculator](https://printgrams.com/tools/resin-print-cost-calculator): Calculate the cost of an SLA/MSLA resin print from the millilitres in your slicer, resin price per litre, IPA, electricity, printer wear and failure rate.
- [Print Time Estimator](https://printgrams.com/tools/print-time-estimator): Estimate 3D print time before slicing from model size, layer height, speed and infill, with hotend flow limits for Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality and more.
- [Magic Layer Heights](https://printgrams.com/tools/magic-layer-heights): Find layer heights that land on whole motor steps for your Z axis: T8×8, T8×4, T8×2, M5 rod or belted Z. Avoid microstep rounding and banding.
- [E-steps, Rotation Distance & Flow Calibration](https://printgrams.com/tools/flow-rate-calculator): Calibrate your extruder: e-steps from a 100 mm extrusion test, Klipper rotation distance, flow multiplier and max volumetric flow vs speed.
- [Shrinkage & Scale Compensation](https://printgrams.com/tools/shrinkage-scale-calculator): Calculate the slicer scale percentage that counters shrinkage in ABS, ASA, nylon, PC and PP, and fix sizes from a calibration cube.
- [Filament Cost per Gram & Metre](https://printgrams.com/tools/filament-cost-per-gram-and-metre): Compare filament spools fairly: cost per gram and per metre from the spool price, net weight and material. Spot when a 750 g spool is pricier than a 1 kg one.

## Key facts
- 1 kg of 1.75 mm PLA (1.24 g/cm3) is about 335 m; 1 m weighs 2.98 g. PETG 327 m, ABS 400 m, TPU 344 m.
- Desktop FDM printers average 50-150 W while printing PLA; a 10-hour print is roughly 1 kWh.
- A full step on a T8x8 lead screw with a 1.8 degree motor is 0.04 mm, so 0.12, 0.16, 0.20, 0.24 mm are "magic" layer heights.
- Etsy US fees (2026): 6.5% transaction + 3% + $0.25 processing + $0.20 listing, charged on item plus shipping.
